msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

lg.l:
kathayi
ṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvān ādbhutāṃs tava ||
lomaśaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ yānapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||

tasya puṇyaphalaṃ ya
t syāt_ tan me brahmahi tapodhana || 2 ||

ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣi
ṇāḥ ||
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ || 3 ||

idam eva purā devās tulayā samato
layan ||
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate || 4 ||

atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ pu
rātanaṃ ||
iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca || 5 ||

varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ
śivi nṛpaṃ ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ || 6 ||

atha taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapo
taḥ śyenatād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ || 7 ||

tataḥ śanair upāgamya
śyenarūddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi || 9 || bhagvān_ kṛpī sureśvaraḥ ||

rājānaṃ sumahātmā
naṃ provācedaṃ vavas tadā || 8 ||
dharmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājan_ mahīkṣitāṃ ||
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi || 9 ||

bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādi
naṃ ||
kṣamayā krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayet || 10 ||

nopakārapareṣv evam upa
kāraparo janaḥ ||
apakārapare pi tvam upakāraparo yathā || 11 ||
ahite hitabuddhis ttaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛta ||
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 12 ||
sadaiva vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānamesu kṣudhā ||

ma hiṃsīr lo
bhato dharmmaṃ dharmmam utsṛṣṭavān asi || 13 ||
saṃtrastarūpī trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ ||

matsakā
śam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ || 14 ||
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayātmanaḥ ||

katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryu
s tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ || 15 ||
lobhāt_ dveṣād bhayād vāpi yastyajeccharaṇāgataṃ ||

brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhu
r manīṣiṇaḥ || 16 ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||

tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ
prāṇino budhaiḥ || 18
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||

jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃti mṛtyos trasyaṃti te
tathā || 19 ||
yannimittaṃ bhavechokas trāso vā krodha eva cā ||

āyāso vā yato mūlam ekaṃgam api saṃtyajet ||
20 ||
mariṣyāmiti yata duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||
yuktas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ ||

yathā
hitaṃ jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ ||

saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣā
m api rakṣa jīvinaṃ || 22 ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam apīm arpayi tathā pareṣārpayiṣye kapotakaṃ ||

yad atra
pruktaṃ manyase karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada || 24 ||
āhārāḥ sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti janeśvara ||
ahāre na vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ || 25 ||
śakyate nyair vināpy arthai rājan_ vartayituṃ ciram ||

na tv ā
hāravihīnena śakyaṃ vartayituṃ kvacit || 26 ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsmān_ mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||

visṛ
ya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃtānam apunarmavaṃ || 27 ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvvaṃ me putradāraṃ mariṣyati ||

rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ
tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi || 28 ||
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapa || 29 ||

avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ
sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ ||

yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan kuru dharmma
vinirṇayaṃ ||
no smād bhūyaḥ paro dharmma kaścid anyo sti khecara ||

prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām a
bhayaṃ yat pradīyate || 30 ||
varam ekasya satvasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā ||
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraphalaṃ kṛtaṃ || 32 ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 32 ||

hemadhe
nudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā vibhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtābhayapradaḥ || 33 ||

mahatā
m api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
bhītābhayapradātasya kṣaya eva na vidyate || 34 ||

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapa
s tīrthaṃ satyaṃ sevā śrutaṃ tathā ||
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya kalā nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ || 35 ||

catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ
yo dadyān pṛthivīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ || 36 ||

api tyajet_ rājyam idaṃ śarī
ra vā sudustyajaṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ || 37 ||

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani ja
nmani ||
bhaveyam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśakaḥ || 38 ||

na hy ahaṃ kāmayet_ rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpuna
rbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhamagnānā kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ || 39 ||

yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛ|
tā ||
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ || 40 ||
āhārārthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgamā ||

tad ya
theṣṭaṃ tavāhāram atyaṃteve dadāmy ahaṃ || 41 ||

ya eva vihito smāsmākaṃ dhātrā bha
kṣaḥ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evītsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryanyair naraiśvara || 42 ||

śyenā kapotān_ ṣādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanā
tanī ||
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha || 43 ||

nāham kuśāstramārgeṇa kvaci
harte vihaṃgama ||
śāstrair eṣopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmaḥ satyadayāparaḥ || 44 ||

sarvasatveṣu yadyaddyenam ekasatve ca yā da
yā ||
sarvasatvapradānnāc dayaivaika viśiṣyate || 45 ||
sarve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara ||

sarvatī
rthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā || 45 ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye ca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādarsitapaṃ
thāno brahmalokaṃ viśaṃti te || 46 ||
gacchatas tiṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā ||

yan na bhūtahitāthā
ya tat paśaur iva ceṣṭitaṃ || 49 ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthavirāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavat parivakṣaṃti te yāṃ
ti paramāṃ gatiṃ || 50 ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ ta yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||

sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhu manī
ṣiṇaḥ || 51 ||
rājyaṃ samastaṃ sumahat prayacchāmi tava dvija ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ || 52 ||
yadi rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||

tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha
me || 53 ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||

etat te haṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ
yāvad ichasi || 54 ||
yad apriyaṃ vastu janā na vadaṃti vadaṃti vaḥ ||

mama ca priyam evaitat_ kasmād abhihi
taṃ cirāt || 55 ||
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||

dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo sūmū
ḍhcetanaḥ || 56 ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ mopayujyate ||

tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate
vṛthā || 57 ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsa janeśvara ||

tasmāt kapotena dhṛtaṃ prayacha
tulayā samaṃ || 58 ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||

yenāsya rakṣaṇa me
syāt tadvat tava vihaṃgama || 59 ||
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||| 60 ||
tyaktvātmasukhabhogechā sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bha
vaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitā || 61 ||
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate ||

puna
ś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ || 62 ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||

tataḥ
prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ || 63 ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

nāpekṣaṃte
mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api || 64 ||
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpa ||

devaduṃdu
bhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāt tataḥ || 65 ||
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ ||

śakraḥ svarūpam ā
sthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata ||
iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ ||

jijñāsamānau
tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau || 67 ||
naitat pūrvve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||

mahākāruṇike
neha yat_ kṛtaṃ duḥkaraṃ tvayā || 68 ||
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tava ||

prāṇasaṃtrāṇalu
bdheṣu na sā prāṇeṣu dehināṃ || 69 ||
parārthaikākalyāṇī svāśayātyaṃtaniṣṭara ||

tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan_
karuṇātaruṇāyate || 70 ||
svakarmapāśaiś ca dṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||

tvaṃ jagat_duḥkhamokṣārthe
baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa || 71 ||
yathā sarvātmanā cāpi deho yaṃ prahṛtaṃ tvayā ||

tathā cāivātmanasthāne vā
sanāpi na vidyate || 72 ||
akṛtvaiṣā viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||

akatvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lo
kottamatāṃ gataḥ || 73 ||
paropakārajanmāno vidhāttā vihitās trayaḥ ||

sajalās tvaṃ ca saphalā
ś ca mahāduḥmāḥ || 74 ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||

sa yāti tatparaṃ sthānaṃ yato
nāvarttate punaḥ || 75 ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ ||

svasvamāṃsāny api dattāni dravye
ṣṭanyeṣu kā kathā || 76 ||
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ ||

sa punar jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parā
rthaṃ hi jīvati || 77 ||
kiṃ cātra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||

na hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte caṃdana
drumāḥ || 78 ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||
sapadaṃ tad avāpnoti parād api hi tat paraṃ || 79 ||
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ ||
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi || 80 ||

yat_ tvaṃ
māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛtāni pārthiva ||
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir lokānaṃ nu cariṣyati || 81 ||

di
vyarūparairaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinī ||
sarvāl lokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ ca yāsyasi ||
evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ ||
rājāpi kratum iṣṭvā tu mumude devavac ciraṃ || 83 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ || 84 ||
viciṃtya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durlabhaṃ ||

śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣanaṃ vidhaya lo
katrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || 85 ||

body.p: || iti śrīmahābhārate itihāsasamuccaye śyenakapotīye nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
